problem_statement: The socket API has no helper that reliably transmits an entire buffer to a connected stream (TCP) peer. zsock_send()/zsock_sendmsg() may return after transferring only part of the data, forcing callers to loop themselves. Add helpers that send all requested data and block (up to a caller-supplied timeout) until everything is sent or an error/timeout occurs: one taking a plain buffer, one taking a net_msghdr. Each helper reports the number of bytes actually sent through an output pointer (which may be NULL), resets it to 0, returns 0 on full success, -ETIMEDOUT if the timeout elapses, -errno on other failures. The helpers are only valid for stream sockets; calling them on a non-stream socket (e.g. UDP) must fail with -EOPNOTSUPP and report 0 bytes sent.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/tcp -s tests/net/socket/tcp/net.socket.tcp -s net.socket.tcp -O twister-out --no-clean -W
